science.title: Why NMN, and why now
science.text: Every cell runs on NAD⁺ — a molecule essential for turning food into energy and keeping your cells repairing themselves. The catch: NAD⁺ levels fall as you age, and that decline is linked with flagging energy and metabolism. NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide) is the most direct precursor your body uses to make NAD⁺ — so supplementing it helps top your cellular energy back up.
